name: ironclad-whirlwind-multi-vulnerable-seed0
description: Whirlwind (X energy, 5 base damage, AllEnemies) at X=3 hits 3 enemies. Per-enemy Vulnerable check happens inside the per-hit damage pipeline (calculate_damage -> VulnerablePower.modify_damage_multiplicative), so each enemy independently receives floor(5 * 1.5) = 7 if vulnerable, else 5. With Vulnerable on enemies 0 and 2 (amount=2 and amount=1 — the multiplier is binary on has_power, not on stack count: see double-vulnerable-stack-seed0) and no Vulnerable on enemy 1, expected damage per X-tick is 7 / 5 / 7. Over 3 ticks: -21 / -15 / -21. Exercises the order of resolution between the outer X-loop and the per-enemy Vuln check; pins the multi-target Vulnerable scaling missing from existing fixtures (parent bead sts2-rs-8z3fl.6).
